Elaine / Jordan — quick pricing + capacity note so we can lock the SOW.

Summary (pilot 3-month):
- Base pilot unit: 3 projects, each with its own API key and baseline quota (100k tokens/month/project).
- Pilot rate: $0.0035 per token (pilot discounted rate), plus $300/month per project for management & monitoring add-on.
- Burst policy: +2x burst available for up to 72 hours per project with auto-throttling beyond sustained burst usage. Pre-authorized burst requests will not require a contract amendment for the pilot.
- If you convert to Dedicated reserved capacity within 90 days, we’ll credit 50% of pilot credits toward committed spend (applies to token spend only).

Procurement / redlines to watch: customer standard amendment to section 5 (indemnities) — we can accept most reasonable changes but will need legal review.

If that aligns I’ll update the SOW pricing table and send a DocuSign link.

—Ben
